name: Duskwood
summary: Duskwood lies beneath a curse, its sunlit past hidden by unending gloom. Stormwind has abandoned its human inhabitants, who cling to survival in Darkshire under the Night Watch's protection. Ghouls, giant venomous spiders, raiding ogres, and savage, mysterious worgen roam its groves and haunted barrows.

sections.title: From Sunlight to Shadow
sections.body: Duskwood was once a rich agricultural tract in the Kingdom of Stormwind, with prosperous settlements such as Grand Hamlet and Raven Hill. Its ruin began when Guardian Medivh fell at Karazhan during the First War, unleashing waves of corrupted fel magic that twisted the woodland into a gnarled, shadowy morass. Spiders became terrifying predators, and fleeing wolves spilled north into Elwynn Forest. Grand Hamlet became Darkshire, where terrified townsfolk were left largely to fend for themselves after the royal garrison withdrew to defend the capital.

sections.title: The Scythe and the Wolf-Men
sections.body: Night elf priestess Velinde Starsong brought the Scythe of Elune to Duskwood. After she vanished in the disused mine called Roland's Doom, prospecting laborer Jitters eventually unearthed the relic. Careless handling of the weapon unleashed worgen, ravenous bipedal wolf-beasts from beyond this world. Shrouded in perpetual mist and bloodlust, these predators tore through the western groves, adding to the misery of a region already burdened by undead curses.

sections.title: A Beleaguered Borderland
sections.body: Commander Althea Ebonlocke and her volunteer militia, the Night Watch, keep Darkshire alive, while Lord Ello Ebonlocke tries to govern the crumbling settlement. Beyond the town's lantern-lit perimeter, danger fills the land. Restless dead raised by the necromancer Morbent Fel stir in massive Raven Hill Cemetery. The Vul'Gol ogres came from Deadwind Pass to claim the south. Dark Riders stalk the crossroads, relentlessly searching for the lost Scythe.

sections.title: The Twilight Grove
sections.body: Near Duskwood's center lies a deep, ancient crater untouched by the surrounding corruption: the Twilight Grove. An ancient Great Tree there holds a dormant portal into the Emerald Dream. Soft, ethereal twilight bathes this unearthly sanctuary in the dying land, while sleeping druidic energies watch over it.

faq.answer: Duskwood was once a vibrant, sunlit province of Stormwind. When Guardian Medivh was slain at nearby Karazhan during the First War, volatile fel energies washed over the forest, choking out the sunlight and twisting the flora. The darkness gave the land its name.

faq.q: Where did the worgen come from?
faq.answer: Night elf Velinde Starsong brought the mystical Scythe of Elune to the region and vanished near Roland's Doom. Years later, a frightened worker named Jitters disturbed the scythe in the mine, unwittingly opening tears that summoned savage wolf-men into the forest.

faq.q: Why are there so many undead in Raven Hill?
faq.answer: Raven Hill Cemetery holds countless souls lost to famine, beasts, and war. The vile necromancer Morbent Fel made his lair on Forlorn Rowe and used dark sorcery to animate the graves into ghouls, skeletons, and abominations.

faq.q: Why hasn't Stormwind sent soldiers to help Darkshire?
faq.answer: With King Varian Wrynn missing and resources stretched thin, Stormwind's regency pulled its military back to protect Elwynn and the throne. Darkshire is left entirely to its own devices, defended solely by the volunteer Night Watch.

faq.q: Who are the Dark Riders stalking the woods?
faq.answer: The Dark Riders are mysterious hooded horsemen from Deadwind Pass near Karazhan. Drawn by the Scythe of Elune's release, they swept into Duskwood and ruthlessly slaughtered Sven Yorgen's family while hunting the artifact.

faq.q: What is the massive tree in the center crater?
faq.answer: The crater is the Twilight Grove, home to an ancient Great Tree. The tree contains a dormant portal to the Emerald Dream, and the grove keeps a calm, mystical twilight distinct from the forest's cursed darkness.

angles.text: As an Alliance holding, Duskwood gets no official troop support from Stormwind. The Night Watch and heroic adventurers alone stand between its people and annihilation.
As a paladin, you face an urgent trial in Raven Hill's desecrated barrows, where Morbent Fel's sinister necromancy calls for the Light.
As a druid, you can study the ancient Great Tree's deep ties to the Emerald Dream and investigate the world's slumbering magic.
As an herbalist, you can find rare plants such as Grave Moss and Kingsblood in the haunted barrows and cursed soil. They draw gatherers willing to brave the restless undead in the cemeteries.
